responsibility: Implements the compiler-provided Rust builtin macro transcribers in the expansion subsystem. This file parses and validates invocation token trees for builtins such as assert!, file!, line!, column!, include_bytes!, include_str!, compile_error!, concat!, env!, cfg!, and include!, performs any eager expansion of nested invocations, converts arguments into AST or token fragments, consults session state, source locations, environment variables, file contents, and cfg predicates as needed, and returns the replacement AST::Fragment or diagnostics that model the builtin macro's compile-time behavior.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file contains the actual builtin macro transcribers and their parsing/helpers, such as string-literal extraction, eager builtin invocation handling, environment/file access, cfg evaluation, and construction of replacement AST::Fragment results. The companion header only advertises the MacroBuiltin handler entry points.
